svg.title: The structure link: a steel frame analysed in Strutrix Studio and saved with its support reactions to the cloud, where FoundaTrix Studio reads them as the loads on a footing at each support and PileAxis reads a support's reactions as the loads at a pile's head, always from the latest saved version
svg.text: Run, then saved: the reactions travel with it
